scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.dev:ui: wait-on -t 30000 http://localhost:4000/api/health && npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --port 5174
